# Camera

Generated from `src/rules.js`, `src/catalogue.js` and `src/engine.js` by `tools/build_docs.py`. Do not edit by hand; edit the sources and run `python3 tools/build_docs.py`. The [settings reference](README.md) says how to read an entry.

### D108

**Auto Power Off**

Msetter: Turn off after. The camera sleeps when you leave it this long.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 120 (2 min)
- Cameras: all

Seconds before the camera goes to standby (M-EV1 manual p.59).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 30 | 30 s |
| 60 | 1 min |
| 120 | 2 min |
| 300 | 5 min |
| 600 | 10 min |
| 1800 | 30 min |
| 3600 | 60 min |

### D051

**Auto Display Off**

Msetter: Screen off after. The screen goes dark sooner to save battery.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 30 (30 s) on the M11, M11-P, M11 Monochrom and M-EV1; 0 (Off) on the M11-D
- Cameras: all

Seconds before the screen turns off (M-EV1 manual p.59).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 30 | 30 s |
| 60 | 1 min |
| 300 | 5 min |

### 0342

**Leica FOTOS image transfer mode**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 4
- Cameras: all

Sets how the camera passes new pictures to the Leica FOTOS app. 4 has the camera tell the app about each new picture. Untested on a camera.

Allowed values: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. The camera's names for them are unknown.
